Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes, and presence of blood, indicating a urinary tract infection. Glucosuria is noted, possibly reflecting hyperglycemia or renal threshold changes. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
